newsitem.title: MEXICO: Corp Geo wins 2,947 housing contracts.
newsitem.headline: Corp Geo wins 2,947 housing contracts.

text.p: Corporacion Geo, Mexico's largest affordable home building company, said on Wednesday it won government contracts to construct 2,947 homes, all of the ones it had bid for.
It said the contracts represented 13 percent of the 23,000 homes auctioned by Fovi, Mexico's World Bank-supported housing fund, granting Geo the largest participation.

The commission to Fovi for the auction was an average 0.5 percent, and Geo agreed to start building the homes in March 1997. About 1,200 of the new homes will be built in the eastern state of Veracruz.
